component.name: GhostPath VPN
component.summary: Native censorship-resistant Linux VPN client with reliable TUN mode

description.p: GhostPath VPN is a high-performance Linux desktop VPN application designed to withstand adversarial network filtering and Deep Packet Inspection (DPI).

ul.li: Full Linux TUN capturing (ghost0) with split tunneling and dedicated routing table priority
Support for VLESS with Reality & Vision, VMess, Trojan, and Shadowsocks
System tray integration with quick connect and auto-start capability
Zero DNS leaks with systemd-resolved and encrypted DoH fallback
Coexistence with WireGuard, OpenVPN, Tailscale, and Docker networks
Direct URI scheme support (vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss://)

screenshot.caption: GhostPath VPN Dashboard with real-time bandwidth metrics

description.p: Initial release of GhostPath native desktop Linux application with Tauri 2.
